# AI Debator Project - Setup Instructions

## Project Overview
Full-stack AI Debator application with voice integration, real-time debates, and scoring mechanisms.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js + Express + Socket.io
- AI Integration: OpenAI API
- Database: MongoDB
- Voice: Web Speech API

## Setup Progress

- [x] Create project structure
- [x] Setup frontend (React + TypeScript)
- [x] Setup backend (Node.js + Express)
- [x] Install server dependencies
- [ ] Install client dependencies (manual step required)
- [ ] Configure environment variables
- [ ] Test the application
- [x] Documentation complete

## Project Features
1. Real-time speech-to-speech debate capability
2. Timer-based evaluation system
3. Structured scoring mechanism
4. Post-debate analysis and summary
5. Leaderboard system
6. Topic search capability

## Development Notes
- Frontend runs on port 5173
- Backend runs on port 3000
- WebSocket for real-time communication
- OpenAI API for AI opponent responses
